notes_for_editor: Only the tnlandforms list speaks to this tower: Johnson County, 4,297 ft (1,309.7 m, matching the record), code FZ2143, tagged cnf, removed. The cnf tag is read as Cherokee National Forest by inference from the list's CNF abbreviation, so the story hedges it and the agency field is not set. Name collision: the Forest Lookouts cache page named buck-ridge.html (eastern_us_lookouts) is a Cumberland County, Pennsylvania tower, and the FFLOS cache has two Pennsylvania Buck Ridge tower sites; none of those is this Tennessee lookout and none is used. No Forest Lookouts Tennessee page for Buck Ridge exists in the cached index. The story is short because the list is the only source; no build, design, staffing or fire evidence was found. The record files FZ2143 under NGS; no source read explains that code, so it is not used. No corrections proposed. Searches: two WebSearch queries, neither returned a Johnson County source beyond the list. Reads: tnlandforms list only.
